text:
Nina (Sales): Orbit Logistics says they're ready to run a 3-week evaluation. Need a quick plan: success criteria, data ingestion path, redaction approach, and cost options (hosted trial vs short-term dedicated). Can we capture owners and blockers?
Leo - Solutions: Proposed success criteria: - p50 latency <= 450ms for 256-token prompts, - p95 <= 1.2s for interactive editor flows, - embedding-based search MRR >= 0.78 on their 4.2k sample docs, - zero unredacted PII in retained logs. Suggest two eval suites: 120 retrieval QA prompts + 60 rewrite/normalization prompts.
Rahul (AM): Customer will stage a 4.2k CSV export in their AWS account (ap-northeast-1). They prefer us to read via cross-account role with strict read-only and KMS CMEK (customer-managed key). They asked if we can return audit logs to their S3 as well.
Talia SRE: Options for ingest: (1) Cross-account IAM role with S3 GetObject; requires review of role ARNs and RT to enable trust (2 business days). (2) Presigned PUTs to our intake bucket — faster but requires them to upload and rotate keys. (3) S3 replication into our intake — more setup. For the pilot I recommend presigned PUTs to keep start fast.
Diego - Eng: Runtime plan: use a 13B open model quantized to 8-bit, enable KV prefix caching, and use batch size 16 for throughput tests. We'll expose a test endpoint with a rate limit matching 5 concurrent editors. I'll provide baseline numbers: token cost estimate and latency matrix.
Nina (Sales): Procurement question: what's the delta for hosted trial vs a 1-month dedicated reserved slab for pilot? They want to know incremental cost if they convert mid-POC.
Leo - Solutions: Ballpark: Hosted trial (3 weeks, modest usage cap): $2.5k-$5k total. Short dedicated month (small pool): $14k-$22k depending on burst allowance. If they convert mid-POC we can roll trial usage into dedicated credits with a small admin fee. I'll follow up with precise quotes.
Talia SRE: Security checklist from Orbit InfoSec: SOC2 scope, KMS/CMEK, data residency, minimal logs, IDS rules on VPC peering, SCA of ingest scripts. We'll ask for their security questionnaire (PDF or OneTrust link). Also need their approved PII taxonomy for redaction.
Rahul (AM): They sent initial SQ: "Orbit_SQ_v2.pdf" — Rahul will upload to the deal record. They also requested a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and confirmation we can rotate keys.
Diego - Eng: Redaction prototype (we'll run this as a first pass): sed + named-entity detection. Example regex we use for obvious tokens:

  sed -E "s/([0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4})/[REDACTED_SSN]/g; s/([A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,})/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g"

We'll also run NER on the raw text and apply customer-provided labels. Any fields they insist on keeping must be listed.
Talia SRE: Logging & retention: for the POC we can keep encrypted request metadata for 30 days. Full prompt bodies will be hashed; full retention requires explicit customer consent. We can export audit logs to their S3 with SSE-KMS using their key.
Nina (Sales): Timeline check: They want to start Tuesday (5 business days). Feasible?
Diego - Eng: If they choose presigned upload: Day 0 (credentials exchange), Day 0-1: upload + redaction pass, Day 2: ingest + smoke tests, Day 3-6: eval runs and tuning, Day 7-14: weekly UX sessions and success gating. If cross-account role chosen, add ~48 hours for role config.
Leo - Solutions: Blockers & owners: 1) Security questionnaire + PII taxonomy (owner: Orbit InfoSec + Rahul), 2) Ingest method decision (owner: Rahul), 3) Trial spend cap & billing contact (owner: Nina), 4) Model selection signoff (owner: Diego).
Rahul (AM): I'll ask Orbit to pick presigned uploads if they want same-day start. Also I'll request the SQ and the PII list by EOD tomorrow.
deploy-bot: sandbox `orbit-eval-1893` created (compute pending S3 access confirmation). Status: queued.
Talia SRE: Action items: - Rahul: confirm upload flow and share role ARNs or presigned manifest. - Orbit: upload PII taxonomy + sample dataset. - Diego: provide baseline latency/cost matrix by Wed (48 hrs). - Nina: confirm spend cap and billing contact.
Nina (Sales): I'll send this summary to Orbit and propose an intake call tomorrow at 10am PT. If there are objections to the criteria/timeline call them out now. Otherwise we'll treat this as our working plan. :white_check_mark:
__note: Single Slack thread string. Contains short messages, code snippet for redaction, bot message, owners, and timeline.
